        public PacROMSetManifestReader(java.io.InputStream inputStream)
        Constructs an instance of the PacROMSetManifestReader class.

        When constructing an instance of this class, the input stream cannot point to null. If this happens, it will throw an error saying that the said object is null.

        Parameters:
        inputStream - The input stream required to read the .pacromsetmanifest file from disk.
        Throws:

    • Method Detail

      • read

        public final PacROMSetManifest read()
                             throws java.io.IOException
        Reads all of the information of the .pacromsetmanifest file.

        By reading the file, it'll first check the file's signature, which should be . Then it will check the version number of the manifest file, which should be . Then it will load all the categorized lists in order: program, graphic, color, palette, sound, and then mystery. If the signature, version number, lists, or manifest entries are invalid or incomplete, it will throw an error, therefore failing the reading process.

        Returns:
        A new PacROMSetManifest loaded from disk.
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - When reading the manifest file fails.
        Since:
        1.0.0

      • close

        public void close()
           throws java.io.IOException
        Closes the manifest reader.

        This will also close the input stream that the reader is using to read the manifest file.
